item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-8483c609cc744e77","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On October 20, 2023, China issued the Global AI Governance Initiative, calling for risk-level testing and assessment, tiered governance, explainability, human control, monitoring, traceability, privacy and data-security rules, ethical review, accountability mechanisms, and international cooperation on AI governance.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the document records a formal policy initiative, but not its implementation or enforcement results.","ruler_attribution":"Issued by China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs under Xi Jinping's government; the source does not identify a personal Xi directive.","limitations":["The source is a formal policy statement and provides no evidence of funding, staffing, enforcement, independent review, or observed outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8483c609cc744e77","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The 2023 Global AI Governance Initiative opposed AI use for manipulating public opinion, spreading disinformation, interfering in other states' internal affairs, or harming sovereignty, and called for prudent and responsible military AI development and prevention of malicious use by terrorists and criminal groups.","question_ids":["1B.9","2B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; records stated policy positions rather than verified conduct.","ruler_attribution":"Issued by China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi order is identified.","limitations":["No evidence is supplied about domestic application, compliance, or whether the stated opposition constrained Chinese information or military practices."]},{"source_id":"SRC-34b6540613e55648","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The State Council adopted the Regulation on the Protection of Minors Online at a September 20, 2023 meeting; it was promulgated on October 16, 2023 and scheduled to take effect on January 1, 2024.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.9","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Formal adoption and promulgation occurred in 2023; implementation was scheduled for 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Adopted by the State Council under Xi Jinping's government; the source does not identify a personal Xi directive.","limitations":["The document establishes formal rules but supplies no evidence of implementation or outcomes during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-34b6540613e55648","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The 2023 minors-online regulation required large or influential platforms to conduct regular child-protection impact assessments, provide minor modes or sections, establish compliance systems and an independent body with external members, stop services for seriously harmful providers, publish annual social-responsibility reports, and accept public oversight.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Rules were enacted in 2023 but scheduled to apply from January 1, 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Established through State Council regulation under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["No evidence shows whether platforms complied, whether oversight was independent in practice, or whether child welfare improved."]},{"source_id":"SRC-34b6540613e55648","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The regulation required personal-information processors handling minors' data to provide access, copying, correction, supplementation, deletion, and qualified transfer mechanisms; initiate incident response and notify affected minors or guardians after breaches; restrict staff access; conduct annual compliance audits; and imposed administrative, civil, and criminal liability for violations.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.8","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Formal requirements were enacted in 2023 with effectiveness beginning in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Established by State Council regulation under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["The source does not document enforcement actions, audit results, or actual protection outcomes in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b3ae0994b3f1032","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The State Council approved the Regulation on the Supervision and Administration of Non-bank Payment Institutions on November 24, 2023; it was promulgated on December 9, 2023 and scheduled to take effect on May 1, 2024.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Formal adoption and promulgation occurred in 2023; implementation was scheduled for 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Adopted by the State Council under Xi Jinping's government; the source does not identify a personal Xi directive.","limitations":["The source records legislation, not enforcement or economic outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b3ae0994b3f1032","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The non-bank payment regulation required licensed institutions to have transparent ownership, qualified directors and senior managers, adequate capital and technical systems, corporate governance, internal controls, risk management, exit plans, and user-protection mechanisms.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.3","5B.4","5B.5","8B.2","8B.4"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Enacted in 2023 but scheduled for implementation in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Established by State Council regulation under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["No evidence is provided about appointment quality, compliance, enforcement, or effects on competition."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b3ae0994b3f1032","start_unit":4,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The regulation required payment providers to use customer due diligence, risk monitoring, real-name accounts, anti-money-laundering and anti-terrorist-financing controls, secure and traceable payment systems, protection of reserve funds and user information, transparent fees, dispute handling, and reporting to the People's Bank of China.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Formal requirements enacted in 2023; the effective date was May 1, 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Established by State Council regulation under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether these controls were implemented or corrected failures during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b3ae0994b3f1032","start_unit":7,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The regulation authorized People's Bank of China inspections, investigations, document and system access, account inquiries, corrective orders, warnings, risk notices, restrictions, suspension, license revocation, and penalties for noncompliance, including obstruction, reserve-fund misuse, unauthorized activity, and concealment.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Enforcement architecture was enacted in 2023 for application from May 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Established by State Council regulation under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["No actual inspection, penalty, audit, or course-correction case is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e428d07f6122630a","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The revised Law on the Protection of Women's Rights and Interests, adopted October 30, 2022, was published as a current policy text in 2023 and took effect January 1, 2023; it made gender equality a basic state policy, required government coordination, development planning, budget inclusion, and statistical monitoring.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.8","6B.9","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Effective throughout 2023, although the revision was adopted in October 2022.","ruler_attribution":"A national law implemented under Xi Jinping's government; the source does not identify a personal Xi directive.","limitations":["The text provides formal safeguards but no 2023 evidence of enforcement, funding levels, or distributional outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e428d07f6122630a","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The women's-rights law required equal political rights and representation measures, investigation of complaints without retaliation, protection from unlawful detention and violence, reporting and handling of trafficking and sexual-harassment cases, and school and employer procedures to prevent and address sexual harassment.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","4B.7","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Applicable during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"A national law implemented under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["No concrete 2023 enforcement action or remedy is documented."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e428d07f6122630a","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The law prohibited gender discrimination in recruitment, pregnancy testing and discriminatory employment conditions; required equal pay, protection against dismissal or reduced benefits for marriage or pregnancy, and labor-inspection coverage of gender discrimination.","question_ids":["5B.8","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Applicable during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"A national law implemented under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["The source does not show actual compliance, inspection activity, or changes in women's employment outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e428d07f6122630a","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The law created or reinforced remedies including complaints, mediation, arbitration, court actions, legal aid, women's federation assistance, public-interest litigation by procurators, a unified women's-rights hotline, supervisory correction of discriminatory local rules, and penalties for retaliation or failure to protect rights.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","4B.7","6B.5","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Applicable during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"A national law implemented under Xi Jinping's government; no personal Xi instruction is identified.","limitations":["No evidence is supplied about use of these remedies or official correction during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1e67b74652620658","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In his New Year address for 2023, Xi stated that China would pursue modernization, economic growth, poverty consolidation and rural revitalization, tax and fee reductions, food security, a science-based COVID response, peace and development, and unity across society.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.9","6B.1","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The address was delivered on December 31, 2022 and stated the program for 2023; it is evidence of declared priorities, not 2023 execution.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping personally delivered the address.","limitations":["The speech gives no independently verifiable implementation or outcome evidence for 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a162c98b6e9695a1","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Freedom House reported that the March 2023 National People's Congress unanimously appointed Xi to an unprecedented third presidential term; official documents and speeches repeatedly identified him as the Party core and invoked Xi Jinping Thought, while reforms created a national data administration and strengthened the Ministry of Science and Technology under a new Central Science and Technology Commission.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.4","4B.5","4B.8","4B.9","8B.2","8B.4"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns the 2023 Two Sessions and institutional reforms.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the appointments, ideological centralization, and reforms to Xi's leadership and the CCP.","limitations":["Freedom House is an external analytical source; the supplied text does not independently establish the legal details of the appointment or the later performance of the new bodies."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a162c98b6e9695a1","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Freedom House reported that Weibo censored searches referring to the 2,952–0 vote reappointing Xi and manipulated trending topics to elevate official achievements.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reported in March 2023 regarding the 2023 National People's Congress proceedings.","ruler_attribution":"The source presents the censorship and trend manipulation as part of the CCP information-control system under Xi's leadership.","limitations":["The source is an external report and the supplied extract does not provide the underlying platform records."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a162c98b6e9695a1","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Freedom House reported that the 2023 Ministry of Finance budget allocated 54 billion yuan to diplomatic endeavors, a 12.2 percent increase from 2022, larger proportionally than increases for defense (7.2 percent), public security (6.4 percent), or science and technology (2 percent); the category included external propaganda and Belt and Road promotion.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.3"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The figures concern the 2023 budget, although the source cautions that they were difficult to verify.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the budget priorities to the CCP government under Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The source says the figures are difficult to verify and does not separate diplomacy from propaganda or establish spending outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a162c98b6e9695a1","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Freedom House characterized Xi's 2023 public posture as more confrontational toward the United States and described his formula of being proactive and daring to fight as a departure from Deng Xiaoping's more cautious approach.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.3","2B.10","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Based on comments and official messaging during the March 2023 Two Sessions, with broader characterization of Xi's decade in power.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the posture and formula directly to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["This is an analytical characterization, not evidence of a specific 2023 use of force or individual coercive decision."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-9f98a7a1d39d9888","SRC-8528f2bcc1798669","SRC-b65eeddc4aa0adb7","SRC-a9f013611262ac90","SRC-99803a6281c57a0f","SRC-84d72d95a911ac65"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents concern 2016 or 2022 rather than Xi Jinping during 2023-2023 and were therefore treated as having no period-fitting material fact.","The Financial Times document is a subscription gate and supplies no substantive article content.","Formal laws and policy statements were not treated as evidence of implementation, enforcement, or outcomes unless the supplied text explicitly documented those facts."]}
